item.title: Strong Pilates To Open Studios in Maryland, Virginia in Latest US Expansion
item.description: Strong Pilates continues to push into the U.S. market, announcing plans to bring eight studios to the Mid-Atlantic just a month after making its California debut.

item.title: The Missing Link in Performance? It Might Be Your Mouth
item.description: As experts connect oral health to inflammation, breathing and recovery, Bon Charge is using everyday habits like brushing to deliver results

item.title: The Business of Padel Is Just Getting Started in the US, Stakeholders Say
item.description: A new wave of entrepreneurs is building padel clubs, leagues, events and digital platforms that could transform the fast-growing racket sport from a niche hobby into a serious business.

item.title: Tension Opens as a Women’s-Only Strength Gym Amid Female Lifting Surge
item.description: Opening in Brooklyn's Williamsburg neighborhood, Tension aims to make weightlifting more accessible, safe and community-driven for women.

item.title: Danone To Buy Celebrity-Backed UK Protein Drinks Maker Huel
item.description: Huel sells ready-to-eat drinks that are fortified with essential nutrients including protein, fat and carbohydrates; the deal is worth a reported $1.1 billion.

item.title: JetSet Pilates Strikes Deals To Expand in Chicago, Boston
item.description: JetSet Pilates is adding as many as 30 locations across the greater Chicago and Boston areas as it continues its nationwide expansion.

item.title: The HVLP 3.0 Era Is Here, Top Gym Operators Say
item.description: High-value, low-price gyms have moved past affordability as their (only) competitive edge, industry executives said at the recent HFA Show.

item.title: YVO Adds to Exec Team, Eyes Emerging Market for Women's Bone Health
item.description: YVO, which makes women's weighted vests that come bundled with DEXA scans, has added marketing vet Chiara Moore as its co-founder and COO.

item.title: AI-Powered Body Composition Scans Are Here – Can They Actually Monitor Health Risk?
item.description: AI-powered body composition scans are making it easier to track body fat percentage, but medical experts are skeptical of their effectiveness.

item.title: Ultrahuman Can Sell in US Market Again Following ITC Resolution
item.description: Ultrahuman is officially back in the U.S., marking its return after a period of disruption tied to an International Trade Commission (ITC) import ban.
